headline: Reasonably priced, mixed analyst view
chart_note: 52-week range: $252.15 - $341.75. Currently $257.08, about 25% below its high.
why_today: McDonald's trades about 25% below its 52-week high with a PE right around its historical norm - analysts call it undervalued, but the rating split (12 Buy, 14 Hold, 2 Sell) shows real disagreement on whether the pullback is a buying opportunity or a warning sign.
pro_1: PE of 20.5x is reasonable for a blue-chip franchise business, and Wall Street consensus flags the stock as undervalued at current levels
pro_2: Steady 2.9% dividend yield from a company with a long history of consistent payouts
con_1: More Hold ratings than Buy ratings - no strong conviction from analysts either way
con_2: 25% drawdown from highs suggests real concern about consumer spending and traffic trends
